blockers.description: Live cross-repo /meta invocation could not be driven: Claude Code's non-interactive workspace-trust-dialog gate ("this workspace has not been trusted") fires before permissions, mode detection, or any skill/agent dispatch, for any freshly-created working directory run via `claude -p`. This is more fundamental than the plan's anticipated AskUserQuestion confirmation gate.
blockers.evidence: Bounded 90s headless attempt from a scratch foreign repo with CLAUDE_AGENT_GLOBAL_ROOT set to a scratch global root produced exactly one line of output (the trust-dialog warning) and exited cleanly with no task created, no commit made, and no real repo touched.
blockers.resolution: Requires a human running Claude Code interactively (which can accept the trust dialog) to complete verification. A copy-pasteable manual verification procedure is recorded in the plan's Phase 5 section.

blockers.resolution: To be exercised once the dependent agent-definition follow-up work lands and/or the manual verification procedure is run.
